svg.title: The granite barrens at Peggy's Point: a rolling whaleback of bare, rounded, jointed granite with grass in the joints, glacial erratics sitting on the pavement, and two tide pools. World y 1000..1280; the walk line is the tile's own bottom edge at world 1280 and content/levels/peggys-cove.json theme.path-light continues the same pavement below it, so nothing is drawn under the ground line (art-bible section 6). Opaque full width from world 1110; ink from world 1024. THE TIDE POOLS ARE WHY THIS TILE HAS WATER IN IT: at the low preset this level keeps two layers and they are the sky and this one, so without them a coastal level would show no water at the tier most phones get. refs/peggys-cove/granite-barrens-and-sea.jpg is a photograph of exactly that pool. Granite MEASURED at hsl(43,7%,58%) and hsl(49,5%,45%) on that file against path-light's hsl(42,6%,67%) and path-base's hsl(36,6%,52%) - one degree of hue and one point of saturation, which is why this level adds no ramp and why `path`, the palette's only near-neutral, is the granite. Nothing here repeats a recognisable object: the tile tiles every 1920 px and carries rock, grass and water and nothing else. NO FIGURES OF ANY KIND APPEAR ON THIS LEVEL - see assets/style/peggys-cove-level.md section 0.
